category_title: Adolescent with autism who fixates on off-topic points and avoids work
scenario_title: Independent work on a difficult worksheet without teacher attention
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a pull-out special education classroom and is expected to complete a difficult independent math worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your math worksheet. Please complete these problems independently.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves the pencil on the desk) Did you see the new movie trailer that dropped yesterday? The main character drives a red sports car.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to focus on the math worksheet right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Stop interrupting me! I'm talking about the movie. The car goes zero to sixty in three seconds.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just start with problem number one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing this stupid math! And tell him to stop looking at me or I'm going to smash his face!
